alter PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPERIODBALANCE_DEP_EOD_RunBalValDate] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD AS (

SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Running Balance of Value Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDE.VALUE_DATE_BAL AS BalanceAmount
	,BDE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS PeriodMonthYear
	,NULL AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE BDE 
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDE.ACID = BDG.ACID
	AND BDE.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1
WHERE BDE.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD where CustomerAccountId is not null;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId),PeriodBalanceTypeId,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)),CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndDate)),convert(numeric(18,5),BalanceAmount),IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId)) 
	HASHROW
	,CustomerAccountId 
	, FinancialInstitutionId
	, PeriodBalanceTypeId
	, PeriodStartDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD 

)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId),PeriodBalanceTypeId,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)),CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndDate)),convert(numeric(18,5),BalanceAmount),IsoCurrencyCode,FinancialInstitutionId)) 
	HASHROW
	, CustomerAccountId
	, FinancialInstitutionId
	, PeriodBalanceTypeId
	, PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' and 	PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31' AND PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Value Date'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId,TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId) AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
	,CASE   WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' 
			ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate 
WHERE (SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW) OR (TGT.HASHROW IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodEndDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate in ('2099-12-31') AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Value Date'



--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
	,SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodEndDate))  AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,SRC.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
	,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT') AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate 


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA;



END
GO
